name: janna_lookup
description: Search the platform's REAL directory and get results you can say aloud: factories & companies (by activity/product and governorate or city), products, tenders, RFQs, retail offers, industrial cities. Use it whenever the visitor asks which factories/suppliers/tenders/offers exist (e.g. «مصانع بلاستيك في الشرقية», "steel factories in Giza"). Say only what the result's `text` and results contain — never invent names, numbers or contacts. Also call janna_search with the same words so the results appear on screen.

query.description: What the visitor is looking for (activity, product, company name, city) in Arabic or English, e.g. بلاستيك

section.description: What to search: factories, suppliers, products, tenders, rfqs, offers or cities (industrial cities/zones)

governorate.description: Optional Egyptian governorate or industrial city in Arabic, e.g. الشرقية or العاشر من رمضان
